name: AI Inventory
summary: Content-first AI/ML discovery — the Tenable AI plugin family plus the software & cpes inventories, plugin output, and network endpoints. Classifies each asset by role; metrics for footprint (share of estate, found beyond the AI plugins), exposure (exposed / unauth endpoints, shadow egress), risk (KEV, critical, EOL, MITRE ATLAS) and governance (ACR vs the role's suggested ACR, already tagged). Per-row 🔍 Why + false-positive suppression. Tags assets AI, AI Role, AI Software, AI Exposed, AI Priority, AI Egress, AI ATLAS (gated) and sets ACR by AI Role (gated).
